## Activity

During July 2024, River Outreach completed 39 captures. This activity provides the basis for the site’s operational review for the month. The capture total should be considered alongside image quality and grading outcomes to identify any issues affecting service delivery.

## Image quality

Of the 39 captures, 9 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 23.1. The proportion of ungradable captures should be monitored to determine whether image acquisition problems are recurring and whether further operational action is required.

The clinic lead has requested that recurring camera issues be logged with the service desk. This will support consistent documentation of equipment-related problems and assist with follow-up.

## Grading

Grading identified 4 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 7. Together, these results describe the grading workload and the time taken for images to progress through review during July 2024. Continued monitoring of the capture, image quality, and grading measures will help River Outreach identify changes in performance and address any persistent camera issues.
